name: xdBot Companion
description: Android64 beta.18 experimental AI button/control correction; native and device tests pending. XD TOOLS and monitor remain removed.

share-after-save.name: Offer to share saved macros
share-after-save.description: After a new xdBot macro file finishes saving, ask whether to open the native sharing UI. No file is sent automatically.

ai-record-experimental.name: Allow experimental AI via START AI button
ai-record-experimental.description: OFF by default. Entering a level never starts AI. Tap START AI in the level, read the warning and confirm to enable and begin; STOP AI, manual input, restart and quitting cancel only the current run without silently changing this preference. Turn this OFF to cancel and disallow AI. Local bounded classic-level timing heuristic only; xdBot replay unverified.
